description: Tiers for `npm run kb:suggest-flood`. A postcode district goes in the first tier whose range contains its share of residential properties at HIGH flood risk (≥ 1 in 30 a year). minShare is inclusive, maxShare exclusive. Districts with fewer residential properties than minResidentialProperties are left out (too small to judge).

tiers.description: Postcode district where many homes are at high risk of flooding from rivers or the sea
Postcode district where some homes are at high risk of flooding from rivers or the sea
